title: ColorCraft profile, version 1
description: A brand color profile from ColorCraft (farger.borresendigital.no). Exported from the profile page as "Profil (JSON)" and imported in the tool under "Fra profilmanual". The importer is lenient: unknown fields are ignored, invalid colors are skipped and extra colors in a group are dropped.

maker.description: Shown as "made by" on the profile page.

link.description: Link to the profile page when exported. Ignored on import.

direction.description: Steers only the generated colors around the brand colors.

role.description: logo: 1-3, the first is the main color. support: 0-4 surface colors. highlight: 0-2, small doses, never surfaces. internal: 0-6, internal use only. main: the main colors of a palette without a profile.

group.description: The group heading as shown on the profile page. Used only when role is missing.

cmyk.description: Four numbers 0-100 separated by spaces, for example "100 80 30 40".

cmykSource.description: manual: from the printed brand guide, kept on import. approx: computed, recomputed on import.

pantone.description: The Pantone number from the brand guide, for example "2945 C". Never converted.

tones.description: Tone scales 50-950 when exported. Ignored on import; they are computed from the colors.

text.description: One rule per line becomes a bulleted list.
